ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a low-density distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels constituting less than 5% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity background with numerous discrete, small-scale high-contrast circular/annular shapes (diameter <20 pixels) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 10% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (irregular peaks and valleys) visible along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave upward sweep along the distal trailing edge ending in tapered, slightly hooked tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular, high-contrast annular clusters (white rings with dark centers) concentrated on the lateral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent horizontal high-contrast linear disruption on the mid-lateral section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (ring marks) and irregular ragged edges at the distal tips of the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific ring-shaped morphology of the scarring is a highly distinctive visual marker compared to solid focal mottling.
